svg.title: Fibroblast
svg.desc: Spread spindle fibroblast with tapering processes, elongated nucleus, actin fibers, rough ER, and secreted collagen fibers. Biological basis: Activated fibroblasts spread on extracellular matrix and synthesize collagen-rich matrix using expanded rough ER and Golgi.
